dialogues.jp: 「学園から商店街までって、割と遠いよな……」
dialogues.en: "People tend to be miserable at those things they like."
dialogues.text: "People tend to be miserable at those things they like."

dialogues.jp:
がったるい。濁点を付けて強調を表現してみた
が、かなりかったるい。
dialogues.en: I keep walking. A little bit more to the bookstore.
dialogues.text: I keep walking. A little bit more to the bookstore.

dialogues.jp:
だが、そんな事も言ってられないのだった。頼
子さんのためである。
dialogues.en: "...... Water leaks from Jaws's hands...?"
dialogues.text: "...... Water leaks from Jaws's hands...?"

dialogues.jp:
暇つぶしになる物を買うために、俺は本屋へと
向かっているのだった。──もちろん、“ヌー”
ではない。
dialogues.en: I keep walking.
dialogues.text: I keep walking.

dialogues.jp: （やっぱ、料理の本が妥当なところだな……）
dialogues.en: "......Fat is thicker than water?"
dialogues.text: "......Fat is thicker than water?"

dialogues.jp:
この前買ってきた本は、どうやら一通り読んで
しまったみたいだし、実際好きだからあれだけ
の進歩があったんだと思う。
dialogues.en: I keep walking.
dialogues.text: I keep walking.

dialogues.jp: 「好きこそ物のあわれなれ、って奴だな」
dialogues.en: "It doesn't sound right......"
dialogues.text: "It doesn't sound right......"

dialogues.jp: てくてく。本屋まで後少しだ。
dialogues.en: "What are you murmuring?"
dialogues.text: "What are you murmuring?"

dialogues.jp: 「……ジョーズの手から水が漏れる？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: てくてく。てくてく。
dialogues.en: "Good evening, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Good evening, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: 「……脂は水よりも濃い？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Moe-sempai! Good evening...... A-Are you sleeping?!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, Moe-sempai! Good evening...... A-Are you sleeping?!"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは。朝倉君」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、萌先輩。こんちは。──って、寝ない
　でくださいよ！」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "No, this is not your dream. This is real."
dialogues.text: "No, this is not your dream. This is real."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en:
"Congratulations, Asakura-kun...... You finally became a
member of the Henderson family......"
dialogues.text:
"Congratulations, Asakura-kun...... You finally became a
member of the Henderson family......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「夢じゃない。夢じゃないっす。めちゃくちゃ
　｛リアル／現実｝です」
dialogues.en: What kind of dream is she having?
dialogues.text: What kind of dream is she having?

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君おめでとう……とうとうヘンダーソン
　さん一家の一員になれたんだね……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'm sorry...... I was half asleep......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm sorry...... I was half asleep......"

dialogues.jp: どんな夢なんだ。
dialogues.en:
"I didn't know what to do when you started dancing naked in
the middle of the road."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't know what to do when you started dancing naked in
the middle of the road."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ごめんなさい……。ちょっと寝ぼけてし
　まいました……」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いくら寝ぼけてるからって、驚きますよ。突
　然、往来の真ん中で裸踊りをされたら」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "......Asakura-kun, you're lying."
dialogues.text: "......Asakura-kun, you're lying."

dialogues.jp:
この間約１０秒である。萌先輩が服装チェック
にかかった時間なり。
dialogues.en:
After checking if she has her clothes on or not, it takes
her 10 seconds to answer.
dialogues.text:
After checking if she has her clothes on or not, it takes
her 10 seconds to answer.

dialogues.jp:
「けど、眠いの押してまで商店街に来たりして、
　何か、買い物ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"But what made you come all the way to the high street
despite being so sleepy? Are you going to buy something?"
dialogues.text:
"But what made you come all the way to the high street
despite being so sleepy? Are you going to buy something?"

dialogues.jp:
まあ、萌先輩が眠そうなのはいつもの事だろう
けど。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai is always sleepy, so it doesn't surprise me so
much that she was walking half-sleeping.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai is always sleepy, so it doesn't surprise me so
much that she was walking half-sleeping.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。花屋さんに行こうと思うんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I'm going to a flower shop."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I'm going to a flower shop."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「へえ、花か。部屋に飾ったりとかするんです
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, flowers. Are you going to put flowers in your room?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, flowers. Are you going to put flowers in your room?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、そうじゃないんですが……」
dialogues.en: "No, not for my room......"
dialogues.text: "No, not for my room......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ごめんなさい、急いでるんでした。それ
　じゃ、私はこれで……」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, excuse me, but I'm in a hurry. So I'll see you tomorrow
at school."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, excuse me, but I'm in a hurry. So I'll see you tomorrow
at school."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん、じゃね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, see you soon."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, see you soon."

dialogues.jp: お互いに手を振り、萌先輩は去っていった。
dialogues.en: We wave at each other and Moe-sempai walks away.
dialogues.text: We wave at each other and Moe-sempai walks away.

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、部屋に飾るんでもないのに花か……」
dialogues.en:
"But why is she buying flowers if they're not for her
room......?"
dialogues.text:
"But why is she buying flowers if they're not for her
room......?"

dialogues.jp: 「……食べるのか？」
dialogues.en: "......Is she going to eat them?"
dialogues.text: "......Is she going to eat them?"

dialogues.jp:
俺みたいな人間には、それしか用途が思いつか
ない。
dialogues.en: A guy like me can't think of anything else but that.
dialogues.text: A guy like me can't think of anything else but that.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、いいや。俺もさっさと用を済ませよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh well. I'd better hurry up as well."
dialogues.text: "Oh well. I'd better hurry up as well."

dialogues.jp: 「ぬおっ。もう夜？」
dialogues.en: "It's dark already?"
dialogues.text: "It's dark already?"

dialogues.jp: トンネルを抜けると雪国であった、てなもんか。
dialogues.en:
It's like the famous poem 'When the train came out of a long
tunnel, there was snow everywhere.'.
dialogues.text:
It's like the famous poem 'When the train came out of a long
tunnel, there was snow everywhere.'.

dialogues.jp: 「割と長々と選んでいたんだな」
dialogues.en: "I took a long time choosing which books to buy."
dialogues.text: "I took a long time choosing which books to buy."

dialogues.jp:
初心者向けのばかり選ぶのもどうかと思い、選
択に悩んだのだ。
dialogues.en:
I was trying to find books not only for beginners but also
for advanced.
dialogues.text:
I was trying to find books not only for beginners but also
for advanced.

dialogues.jp:
結局、内容的に難しそうなのから簡単そうなの
まで、何冊か買う事にしたのだった。
dialogues.en:
In the end, I decided to buy several books with a range of
difficulties from challenging to easy ones.
dialogues.text:
In the end, I decided to buy several books with a range of
difficulties from challenging to easy ones.

dialogues.jp: 「さて。さっさと帰ろっと」
dialogues.en: "I'd better go home."
dialogues.text: "I'd better go home."

dialogues.jp: 日が落ちて肌寒い風の中、家路を急ぐ。と──。
dialogues.en: I'm walking home fast in the cool evening wind, when......
dialogues.text: I'm walking home fast in the cool evening wind, when......

dialogues.speaker: Young man
dialogues.jp: 「あの、すいません」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me."

dialogues.speaker: Young man
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp:
何の変哲もない、量産型といった感じの青年に
呼び止められた。
dialogues.en: I get stopped by a young man who looks pretty normal.
dialogues.text: I get stopped by a young man who looks pretty normal.

dialogues.speaker: Young man
dialogues.jp:
「これ、いいですか？　いえ、勧誘とかじゃな
　くて猫を探してるんです」
dialogues.en:
"Can you take a look at this flyer? I'm not selling
anything. I'm looking for a cat."
dialogues.text:
"Can you take a look at this flyer? I'm not selling
anything. I'm looking for a cat."

dialogues.jp:
差し出してきた紙を受け取る。それは、もはや
俺にとって馴染み深い、アレだった。
dialogues.en: I take the flyer he gives me. It's the familiar flyer.
dialogues.text: I take the flyer he gives me. It's the familiar flyer.

dialogues.speaker: Young man
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます。それでは」
dialogues.en: "Thank you so much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you so much."

dialogues.jp:
青年はぺこりと頭を下げ、商店街の中へと消え
ていった。
dialogues.en: The young man bows and walks towards the high street.
dialogues.text: The young man bows and walks towards the high street.

dialogues.jp: 「おお、すげえな」
dialogues.en: "Wow, he's really working hard."
dialogues.text: "Wow, he's really working hard."

dialogues.jp: 道行く人に加え、お店の人にも配っている。
dialogues.en:
He's giving the flyer not only to passersby but also to
stores on the street.
dialogues.text:
He's giving the flyer not only to passersby but also to
stores on the street.

dialogues.jp:
「ご苦労なこった。バイトか？　あの上流階級
　の一家の一員には、どうにも見えないが……」
dialogues.en:
"Hard worker...... Is he doing it as a part-time job? He
doesn't look like a member of an upper class family......"
dialogues.text:
"Hard worker...... Is he doing it as a part-time job? He
doesn't look like a member of an upper class family......"

dialogues.jp:
呟き、例のチラシを｛かばん／鞄｝の奥に押し込むと、俺は
商店街を後にしたのだった。
dialogues.en: I put the flyer in my bag and leave the high street.
dialogues.text: I put the flyer in my bag and leave the high street.

dialogues.jp: ◆チラシ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんの暇つぶしにでもなればと、料理の本
を買いに本屋へ向かった俺だが、途中、萌先輩
に会った。
dialogues.en: It's a pain in the neck! It really really sucks.
dialogues.text: It's a pain in the neck! It really really sucks.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は花屋にいくらしい。急いでいるという
ことだったので、そこで別れた。
dialogues.en:
But I can't keep complaining, because this is for
Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text:
But I can't keep complaining, because this is for
Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp:
本屋でしばらく本を見ているといつの間には日
は落ちていた。
dialogues.en:
I'm walking to a book store to buy some books for her so she
won't be bored all day at home. But for your information,
I'm not buying "Nu".
dialogues.text:
I'm walking to a book store to buy some books for her so she
won't be bored all day at home. But for your information,
I'm not buying "Nu".

dialogues.jp:
家路を急ぐ俺に声を掛けてきた青年、多分バイ
トだろう。渡されたチラシには見覚えがあった。
dialogues.en: (I should buy cookery books......)
dialogues.text: (I should buy cookery books......)

dialogues.jp:
それは、杉並から見せられた、電柱に貼ってあっ
た。あの『チラシ』だった。
dialogues.en:
She already read all the books I bought her last time. And
because she really liked them, she learned fast.
dialogues.text:
She already read all the books I bought her last time. And
because she really liked them, she learned fast.
